messages:
Maya (Design): quick UX question: axis labels are wrapping awkwardly on narrow widths. i prototyped two strategies: 1) truncate + tooltip, 2) switch to compact units (SI prefixes) and multiline axis. which is less confusing?
Ethan (Eng-Frontend): truncate+tooltip is easiest to ship, but tooltips are fragile on touch. compact units require conversion logic but look cleaner.
Noor (DataViz): compact units (e.g., 1.2k, 3.4M) help for magnitude. prefer dynamic unit scaling per-axis: choose unit so labels stay under 6 chars. fallback to full unit in legend.
Maya (Design): idea: show full unit in legend header with aria-label and a secondary small toggle: "Units: Auto | Raw". Auto picks SI prefix; Raw shows original units (ms, bytes).
Riley (PM): product constraint: many users misunderstand k vs thousand. if we use SI, microcopy must clarify: "k = thousand, M = million" where relevant. default to Auto but expose Raw in settings.
Ethan (Eng-Frontend): accessibility: any truncated label must have aria-label with expanded text. tooltips need focusable trigger for keyboard users. touch fallback: long-press to reveal.
Noor (DataViz): smoothing preview question: when hovering legend, can we show a mini-preview toggle that applies a local smoothing preview without changing global state? Helpful for trial.
Maya (Design): preview control: hover legend -> little eye icon opens a small preview layer. clicking persists smoothing. keyboard: focus legend item then press 'p' to preview (doc this).
A11yBot: reminder: keyboard shortcut must be discoverable in help; any preview must have accessible state announcements (aria-live) e.g., "Preview smoothing enabled for Series X". Ticket #688.
Riley (PM): outlier handling: for breakpoint/narrow views where axis space is limited, prefer soft-clamp + inline count instead of rescaling. show "(3 clipped)" next to series name. provide action to expand axis.
Ethan (Eng-Frontend): backend will return axis_meta: {unit_suggestion: "k", clipped_count: 3} to help UI. we'll sample for percentiles to reduce compute.
Maya (Design): microcopy suggestions: axis tooltip: "Values shown with SI prefixes for space. Toggle to view raw units." clamp tooltip: "Some values clipped for readability. Click to expand axis." badge text: "clipped".
Noor (DataViz): visual treatment: when compacting units, keep axis tick spacing consistent. avoid changing tick count.
Riley (PM): rollout: Auto units + truncate fallback in next sprint; preview smoothing and clamp count in follow-up. include a11y review on QA.
Maya (Design): i'll update mocks, add responsive states and keyboard flows, then drop images here. thanks!
